dog.description_text:
⚖️ 6.5 pounds
🐾 Potential Hound Mix
Winnie is a feisty, playful little girl who LOVES to be the center of attention! Running, playing, and ALL the toys are what life is about for this little cutie! 🧸🐾
She's already working on her puppy skills! She's beginning pad potty training and learning to sit and shake (especially when treats are involved! 😂). She's eager to learn, but let's face it — playing is WAY more fun!
dog.name: Winnie
